name: Ogolale (Mashed Yam and Plantain)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Boil the yam and plantain in a pot of salted water until cooked through.
Drain the water, and transfer the cooked yam and plantain to a clean container.
Use a spoon or spatula to mash the yam and plantain.
Adjust seasoning to taste, and serve.
